NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image of the area in front of it using its onboard Front Right Hazard Avoidance Camera A. 

This image was acquired on Sept. 13, 2026 (Sol 1978) at the local mean solar time of 15:48:50.

images.caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its onboard Left Navigation Camera (Navcam). The camera is located high on the rover's mast and aids in driving. 

This image was acquired on Sept. 13, 2026 (Sol 1978) at the local mean solar time of 15:44:35.
